meta.source: Timefix 2026 refresh, 9 Nov 2026. Evolved from packages/tokens/tokens.json (v1, Attio-derived): same token roles and most names, zero-tint neutrals, one solid focus ring, Geist type, a 4px grid and calmer elevation. Retuned 9 Nov 2026 to the owner's 20 references: grey canvas with white cards in tinted shells, larger concentric radii, ink primary with blue for selection, hue-coloured status tags with icons, medium-weight titles. Motion tokens replaced by the transitions.dev scale (owner, 9 Nov 2026).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The app's outermost ground. The sidebar sits directly on it; the working area is one white surface panel inside it.

tokens.name: surface-shell
tokens.usage: The tinted outer shell around groups of white cards: board columns, grouped table sections, stat rows, the getting-started block. Shell padding 6px, shell radius radius-xl, cards inside radius-lg.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main working surface: tables, record pages, settings content, cards on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. Pair with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Filled inputs at rest, the table header strip, segmented-control track, icon wells, code.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, menu items, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: A pressed ghost button, the open menu trigger, the highlighted menu item via keyboard.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers in tables and lists, separators inside cards.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines, the sidebar edge, secondary button outline.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed drop zones and hover outlines on cards.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Checkbox, radio and switch outlines at rest. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting lines, descriptions, inactive tabs and nav labels. 6:1 or better on surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, column headers, empty values. Still 4.5:1 on surface, surface-subtle and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ink. The primary button and the selected thumb of an ink segmented control. One per view region.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 17:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The Timefix blue, for selection and time: the chosen date or slot, selected rows, the active tab underline, checked boxes and switches, meeting blocks, progress. Not for the main button (that is primary).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for anything filled with accent. Darker in both themes so on-accent keeps 5.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the chosen time slot's ground, accent badges.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Blue text and icons on an accent-soft fill: open days, selected chips, time wells. Stays readable in dark.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Outline of an accent-soft element: available time slots, selected cards.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. 5.8:1 light, 4.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and the accent as text on surface (dark lifts it to stay 8:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline on every interactive element, offset 2px. Solid, 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, connected, paid. Always with a check icon or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a success callout or toast icon well.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: expiring tokens, conflicts, limits near. With a triangle icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning callout.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, invalid fields. With an icon or word; never the only signal.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger callout and a destructive menu item's hover.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled danger button (dark text in dark theme, where danger is light).

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI attributes, suggestions and the assistant. The only violet in the product.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips, the bulk action bar, toasts.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: dot-gray
tokens.usage: Status dot and select option colour: neutral.

tokens.name: dot-red
tokens.usage: Status dot and option colour: red.

tokens.name: dot-orange

tokens.usage: Status dot and option colour: yellow.

tokens.name: tag-gray-bg

tokens.name: tag-gray-text
tokens.usage: Tag text and its icon on tag-gray-bg: the hue itself, 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.usage: Tag text and its icon on tag-red-bg: the hue itself, 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-lime-text

tokens.usage: Tag text and its icon on tag-green-bg: the hue itself, 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Public pages only: the booking page host line, a form's title, an empty workspace's welcome. Never inside the app chrome.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Record name on a record page, a settings page title, a note title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, panel titles, section titles on long pages.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, the page title in the top bar, group headings inside a panel. Medium weight like every title; hierarchy comes from size.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick a time that works for you.
styles.usage: Public booking and form pages, where guests read on phones. Also the input text on those pages (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, menu items, record names in cells, the actor in an activity line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Moved to Qualified about 3 hours ago
styles.usage: Default app text: cell values, attribute values, descriptions, activity.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, sidebar section labels, tag text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, timestamps, metadata lines.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keycaps in menus, buttons and the command palette.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API keys, webhook URLs, IDs, embed snippets.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Same role, same step, everywhere.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, focus ring offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tag, between stacked label and value lines, menu outer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside buttons, chips and nav items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar; menu item horizontal padding; label to field.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Cell horizontal padding, button horizontal padding, gap between form fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between form fields stacked, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), sidebar inner gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, page gutter on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Empty state vertical padding, public page top margin.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Public page hero spacing on desktop.

radius.note: Concentric: an inner radius is the outer one minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, keycap, status dot square, code inline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, record chips, small menu items, calendar day cells, icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, time slots, toasts, menu items in large menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the main surface panel, cards inside a shell (radius-xl minus the 6px shell padding).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Shells, dialogs, menus, the command palette, the record panel, the public booking card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, search fields, avatars, switches, count badges, filter chips, the selected nav pill.

shadow.note: Light theme lifts with soft shadows; dark theme lifts with a lighter surface and a 1px inner edge.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs on surface-subtle, the segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on canvas; a dragged row at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, select listboxes, date pickers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, the command palette.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, filter chips, inline icon buttons in rows.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and segmented control height in the app.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Public page buttons and inputs, settings fields, sign in, onboarding. 16px text.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Table row and list row height.

tokens.name: size-nav-item
tokens.usage: Sidebar nav item and menu item height.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Page top bar height.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default Lucide icon box.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in empty states' wells, callouts and the public pages.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar in rows, chips and activity. Record header uses size-avatar-lg.

tokens.name: size-avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Record header and host photo on the booking page.

tokens.name: size-menu
tokens.usage: Minimum menu width.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Default dialog width.

tokens.name: size-dialog-wide
tokens.usage: Wide dialog: import, embed code.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Side panel / record peek width.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max line width for settings forms and long text.

duration.note: The transitions.dev scale. Choose by usage, not by number; exits are faster than entries.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Per-item stagger offset in lists, digits and text lines.

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Tooltip and path delays, error shake segments, a large stagger.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover washes, presses, menu, select and modal close, text swap, tooltip appear, checkbox fill.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Menu, popover, select and dialog open; icon swap; tab and segmented pill slide; page slide.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Drawer and toast close, the checkbox tick drawing, the switch thumb travel.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Drawer and panel open, skeleton-to-content reveal, input clear.

tokens.name: duration-very-slow
tokens.usage: Emphasis only: a success check, a badge appearing, a hero text reveal, rolling digits.

tokens.name: ease-smooth-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything that opens, closes, moves or resizes: menus, dialogs, drawers, pills, rows, presses.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Crossfades: icon swap, text swap, text reveal, skeleton reveal.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Tooltips and hover colour changes.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Spinners, shimmer, skeleton pulse.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Small pops: a badge or count appearing, the switch thumb overshoot, a digit landing.

tokens.name: ease-bounce-strong
tokens.usage: Only the springy return of a hovered avatar or chip stack.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header and first column.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, listboxes.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Side drawers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, above everything.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Pair with cursor not-allowed and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: opacity-busy
tokens.usage: A control while its action is in flight (spinner shown).

tokens.name: border-width-hairline
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider.

tokens.name: border-width-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline and the active tab underline.

tokens.name: distance-micro
tokens.usage: Text swap, overlay offset from its trigger on open.

tokens.name: distance-small
tokens.usage: Error shake small segment.

tokens.name: distance-base
tokens.usage: Toast rise, page slide, badge reveal, error shake large segment.

tokens.name: distance-medium
tokens.usage: Text line reveal, a new row dropping in.

tokens.name: distance-large
tokens.usage: A check badge arriving.

scale.note: Starting scales for surfaces as they open and close; presses use scale-medium.

tokens.name: scale-large
tokens.usage: Dialog open and close; icon-button press.

tokens.name: scale-medium
tokens.usage: Menu, popover and select open; button press.

tokens.name: scale-small
tokens.usage: Tooltip open.

tokens.name: scale-tiny
tokens.usage: Menu and popover close.

blur.note: Soft cross-blur that hides the seam of a swap.

tokens.name: blur-small
tokens.usage: Text and icon swap, number pop-in, panel and skeleton reveal.

tokens.name: blur-medium
tokens.usage: Page slide, text reveal.

tokens.name: blur-large
tokens.usage: Success check arriving.
